mapper.sql: id, resource_id, file_id, parent_version_id, version_no, branch, change_log, editor_id, is_rollback, rollback_from_version_id, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_version (resource_id, file_id, parent_version_id, version_no, branch, change_log, editor_id, is_rollback, rollback_from_version_id, created_at) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{fileId}, #{parentVersionId}, #{versionNo}, #{branch}, #{changeLog}, #{editorId}, #{isRollback}, #{rollbackFromVersionId}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM resource_version WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM resource_version WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY version_no DESC, id DESC

SELECT v.id, v.resource_id, v.file_id, v.parent_version_id, v.version_no, v.branch, v.change_log, v.editor_id, v.is_rollback, v.rollback_from_version_id, v.created_at, f.file_name, f.file_size, u.nickname AS editor_name FROM resource_version v LEFT JOIN file f ON f.id = v.file_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.editor_id WHERE v.resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC, v.id DESC
